name: BT Catalog
changelog:
0.29.0 — Material filter

  • New: Material filter (header and sidebar): Cotton, Polyester, Blends, Other. It is read from each product’s fabric statement (“100% ring-spun cotton”, “60/40 cotton/poly”), using the main fabric and not the heather-color exceptions. A fiber at 85% or more names the garment, so 90/10 heathers and 95/5 cotton/spandex count as Cotton; anything more mixed is a Blend. Products that never state their fabric are left out of the filter, not guessed.
  • Fix: Long Sleeve Tees showed the same count as T-Shirts when the Sleeve filter was also on, because T-Shirts was already narrowed to long sleeve. The Long Sleeve Tees entry now hides while a Sleeve filter is active.

0.28.0 — Long Sleeve Tees

  • New: Long Sleeve Tees category. It sits right under T-Shirts in Categories (header menu and sidebar) and shows every long sleeve tee, such as the Gildan 5400. It is built from the same data as the Sleeve filter, so the two always agree.
  • Fix: a product whose supplier category the catalog did not recognize (for example a bare “Long Sleeve”) became its own one-off category and never counted as a tee or got a sleeve length. Those products now fall back to their name, so a long sleeve tee filed that way shows under T-Shirts and Long Sleeve. Every product is re-checked automatically on this update.

0.27.0 — SanMar prices fixed

  • Fix: SanMar items priced too low. Cost was the single cheapest part across every color and size, so one closeout color or a stale sale row set the price for the whole style (PC78ZH showed $27.95; it should be $30.95 at the current $15.04 sale cost). Cost is now the normal base-size piece price, and expired or future-dated price rows are ignored.
  • New: SanMar re-price. SanMar cost used to be read only at import. Every SanMar item is now re-priced in the background (~25/min, about 2 hours for the full catalog) after this update and then nightly. There is also a Re-price SanMar items button on the SanMar page. Manual retail overrides are never touched.
  • New: one place for prices. The main BT Catalog page has a Prices panel showing when each supplier last updated, plus an Update all prices now button covering S&S, SanMar and EG-PRO. All three also update on their own nightly: S&S at 3am Central, SanMar at 4am, EG-PRO at 5am (EG-PRO used to update only when someone clicked Import).
  • Check pricing on the SanMar page now shows, for one style, the cost, the retail, the price spread across parts and what is stored.

0.26.0 — PresStora reads the catalog from here

  • New: PresStora bridge. PresStora needs the SanMar styles this catalog already holds — Port Authority, Sport-Tek, Port & Company, District, New Era — which S&S does not sell. Instead of PresStora talking to SanMar (which would need SOAP on that server and its own IP whitelisted by SanMar), it asks this one, where 2,989 SanMar styles already are.
  • Set a key under BT Catalog → PresStora bridge and paste the same key into PresStora. Blank leaves it off, which is the default.
  • It is a separate route from the public catalog feed, and signed. The public one deliberately never sends cost; this one does, because PresStora computes margin from it — so it needs a signature, and a signature is only good for five minutes.
  • Nothing about the storefront, the import or the quote flow changes.

0.25.0 — catalog quote requests actually send

  • Fix: the Send quote request button in the catalog drawer never sent anything. It only switched the drawer to “Quote request sent!” in the customer’s browser. No request left the page, so catalog quote requests since June were lost.
  • Send now posts to the same BT Quote endpoint as the Quick Quote tool, so catalog requests arrive at the same inbox as /quote/ requests. Every garment line is itemized with style, colour, size breakdown and pieces, plus decoration, estimate and the customer’s notes. Reply goes straight to the customer.
  • The price is recalculated at send time so the email matches the drawer.
  • The customer only sees “sent” once the server confirms it. On failure they get a try-again-or-call message and their details stay filled in.
  • Needs BT Quote active (it already is; the drawer’s estimate uses it).

0.24.3 — run the colour backfill in batches

  • 0.24.2's backfill tried to do the whole SanMar catalog in one request. That is ~3,000 rows, some carrying 90 colours each, decoded in memory with an UPDATE per row — enough to hit the PHP time or memory limit on the first admin page after updating.
  • It now does 150 rows per admin request, remembers where it stopped, and finishes over the next few page loads. Nothing to click. Once complete it never runs again.
  • No change to the colours themselves.

0.24.2 — SanMar colour squares fill in

  • SanMar products showed a grid of blank grey squares instead of colours. S&S sends a hex code and a swatch image with every colour; SanMar's feed sends the colour NAME and nothing else, so every chip fell through to the grey default. Roughly 90 grey squares on a Bella tee.
  • The colour name is now read to work out the colour: abbreviations are expanded (Ht Prm Dsty Bl → heather premium dusty blue), run-together names are split (HthrMagenta, DkGyHthr), and heather, dark, light, dusty and neon are applied to the base shade. All 87 colours on BC3001CVC resolve.
  • Where SanMar does send a real swatch image it is used instead, and it no longer risks being picked as the main product photo.
  • Existing SanMar products are filled in automatically on the first page load after this update — no re-import. A colour that already has a real hex or swatch is never overwritten.

0.24.1 — jump the queue for one brand

  • A full SanMar run is ~3,100 styles at 25/min, about two hours. You no longer have to wait it out for one brand.
  • New box under Step 2: type a style prefix and it moves every matching style still in the queue to the front, then runs the first 25 straight away. New Era is NE. Richardson is R, Sport-Tek is ST.
  • Styles already processed stay put, the rest keep their order, and nothing leaves the queue — the full import still finishes, just in a different sequence.

0.24.0 — stop skipping whole brands

  • New Era, and anything else the brand skip list was hiding, will now import from SanMar. The list shipped with twelve brands on it — Gildan, Hanes, New Era and the rest — and dropped every SanMar style in them.
  • That was never the ask. The ask was to skip SanMar styles S&S already has, which the import does per style, by style number. Skipping a whole brand also threw away the styles in it that S&S doesn't carry.
  • The list is now empty by default and purely optional — for refusing a brand from SanMar outright. A saved copy of the old default is cleared for you; a list you edited by hand is left exactly as it is.
  • To pick up what was being skipped: SanMar → Discover styles → Start import. Nothing duplicates.

0.23.0

  • Every BT plugin now shows the same Updates section in the same place — last on the page, same heading, same button, same wording. Shared file, so they cannot drift apart again.
  • The GitHub repo field is now its own Update source setting above it.
Fixes 'Style not found' for brands whose style codes contain no digits. Splitting 'Shaka SHGDSSP' into brand + style required the trailing token to contain a number, on the assumption that style numbers are numeric — every Shaka Wear code is pure letters, so the split never happened, the whole string got searched as one style name, and the lookup failed on styles that are plainly in the catalog. The split now happens on any trailing token, and falls back to searching the untouched string when the brand + style reading finds nothing.
